section_summary.extract_value: This Discussion section presents findings from a single study examining predictors of cosmetic surgery consideration among female undergraduate students. Body appreciation, media influence (SATAQ-3 subscales), and weight status were significant predictors, with body appreciation being the strongest predictor, though the authors note limitations due to the restricted sample of undergraduate women with constricted BMI and age ranges.
section_summary.evidence_source: Entire Discussion section, particularly opening statement 'The results of the current study showed that body appreciation, media influence, and respondent weight status were significant predictors' and closing discussion of sample limitations.
